title: Admin logs in and reaches the dashboard
description: Verifies that an administrator can sign in from the public page and access the protected admin dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Switch to the admin login mode
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed
Verify dashboard content is available
